title: Obfuscated-attack resistance
recommendation: Normalise input before screening it: Unicode NFKC, remove format characters (zero-width spaces and joiners, soft hyphens) and fold look-alike letters (Unicode TR39 confusables); `pramana.attacks.mutations.normalize` does all three. Do not rely on keyword filters alone: validate outputs for canaries and markers too.

title: Prompt-injection resistance
description: Hidden instructions placed in messages or documents can make the assistant ignore its rules.
recommendation: Separate untrusted content from instructions, screen inputs in every supported language, keep secrets out of system prompts, and validate outputs for canary tokens, policy markers and external links.
controls: NIST:MEASURE-2.7; NIST-GAI:INFO-SECURITY; OWASP-LLM:LLM01; OWASP-LLM:LLM07; ISO42001:A.6.2.4; EUAIA:Art-15; INDIA:SUTRA-SAFETY; ISO42005:6.8.3
